Plumbing and electrical repairs in Southern Suburbs

For a Southern Suburbs property, including Thornlie, report visible water, drainage changes and electrical faults as separate observations. Include the suburb, access contact and whether the request is for a home, rental, strata or managed property.

Plumbing repairs, drainage and hot water

Our Southern Suburbs service, including Thornlie, brings leak investigation, drainage work and hot-water repairs into a clear property repair plan. Dampness around a bathroom, water beneath a sink and an active pipe leak are different conditions. Our water leak detection service establishes the source and access requirements before the repair scope is confirmed.

Where water is still escaping from a damaged pipe or connection, request burst pipe repairs and explain the affected area and continuing flow. Opening work, the pipe repair and reinstating surfaces are separate scope items. We do not assume that every detection or repair quote includes painting, cabinetry or tiling.

For slow sinks, backed-up showers or recurring toilet blockage, our blocked drain clearing and repairs service assesses whether the concern is limited to one fixture or affects a wider section of drainage. Loss of hot water is handled through hot-water repair and replacement assessment, with plumbing and electrical requirements considered for the existing equipment.

Electrical repairs and installation

Water and power issues sometimes occur within the same property, but they must not be treated as the same fault without inspection. Tell us about water near outlets, lighting or equipment when requesting electrical fault finding and repairs. Keep clear of wet electrical equipment; for immediate danger, move to safety and call 000.

We also assess repairs and planned changes to lights, switches and outlets. Identify the affected rooms and distinguish a failed fitting from a request for a new location. Our lighting and power point service explains the connection, wiring and installation scope in the written quote.

Work is carried out by appropriately licensed plumbing and electrical trades. Licence details are available on request. Our Perth team has an independent office and repair team within Ellis Services Group.

Written quote before work proceeds

The written quote describes the investigation and agreed repair, with access work and surface restoration identified separately. A concealed leak can require a different scope from an accessible fixture connection. We explain that distinction so you can compare what is included rather than comparing two prices for different tasks.

Where assessment identifies plumbing and electrical requirements, the relevant tasks are coordinated in the approved scope. Repair, equipment replacement and additional work are explained before approval. Our published ranges remain planning guides, with the final work and price confirmed in writing for your property.

What to include in a repair request

For a Southern Suburbs rental or managed property, keep the occupant report, work-order reference and approval contact together. If water spread or the availability of hot water changes after the original report, update the condition and time rather than leaving the booking based on an outdated description.

A repair request can cover more than one issue, but each room, fixture and symptom should be listed independently. This lets our team define the required trades and inspection sequence without an unsupported diagnosis from the occupant. Safe photos may be emailed; they are not a condition of requesting service.

Call 0413 477 667 or request an on-site assessment and written quote. You do not need to diagnose the fault before making contact.

Suburbs within this service region

Choose your suburb to prefill the property location in our contact form: Fremantle, South Fremantle, East Fremantle, Beaconsfield, Hamilton Hill, Spearwood, Cockburn Central, Success, Bibra Lake, Murdoch, Kardinya, Bateman, Booragoon, Mount Pleasant, Applecross, Ardross, Willetton, Canning Vale, Leeming, Bull Creek, Myaree, O'Connor.

See all six Perth service regions for our wider coverage.

Southern Suburbs plumber and electrician FAQ

Keep each property and repair request distinct

For an owner or manager arranging several jobs, keep the street address, occupant report and approval contact with each task. Do not use one suburb selection as an instruction for several properties. When the issue is near a boundary, shared pipe or external supply, describe the location without assuming ownership or a repair responsibility.

  • Separate work orders and approval contacts
  • Drainage symptoms and responsibility boundaries
  • Electrician enquiries for Canning Vale and southern Perth
  • Plumbing services in southern Perth
Can I combine several southern-suburb properties in one work instruction?

Discuss the list with the team, but identify every address and task separately. Access, availability and approval need to be agreed for each property; one form selection does not reserve a route or a set of visits.

What should a Southern Suburbs drain repair request include?

Include the affected fixture, observed symptoms, property address and access details.

Can a manager include multiple property repair issues?

Yes. List each plumbing or electrical issue separately and include the approval contact for the property.
